Hi Jordan — great to hear from you and thanks for the proposed slots. Quick ping on times: Europe moved off DST a week earlier (last weekend of October), while the US switches on Nov 7. That one-week window causes some common slot-mapping confusion.

When your generator shows 09:00 AM ET / 15:00 CET for Nov 12, that mapping only lines up if both sides are on standard time. Because the US will also switch to standard time on Nov 7, Nov 12 should be OK — but I want to be explicit so no one shows up an hour early/late. To avoid ambiguity, can we lock by UTC?

Option A (preferred): Nov 12, 15:00 UTC — that corresponds to 10:00 AM ET and 16:00 CET on Nov 12 (everyone on standard time).
Option B: Nov 12, 14:00 UTC — 09:00 AM ET / 15:00 CET if you definitely prefer the 9am ET window.

Jonas & Neha — do either of these work for the EU engineering squad? We can take the deep-dive and make sure we share a recording.

Cheers,
Hannah
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
